constraints: evidence spans must match their exact source text and character width
note fact IDs must be unique and every active fact must be referenced exactly once
note statements have unique IDs, reference exactly one existing fact, and preserve that fact text
source-linked note statements must reference the exact transcript version and evidence span
clinician-entered facts and statements cannot carry audio evidence
amendments must reference an existing note in the same encounter and cannot amend themselves
approval, note, transcript and export references are checked at route/transaction boundaries

limitations: Domain referential checks validate saved structures and source links; they do not establish clinical truth.
The migration and route tests use synthetic records. No production database or patient data was used.
